integratedControl.title: Integrated control
controlInspection.taskScope: Visible workspace tasks and their primary sessions. This list is not the global admission population.
controlInspection.sample: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} tasks. Open the task list for all tasks.
controlInspection.emptyTasks: No unarchived tasks in this workspace.
controlInspection.noReason: The population is unknown. The server did not provide a failure reason; visible task sessions cannot establish global occupancy.
controlInspection.historyHelp: Unified history is not available yet. Existing conversation and session history remains in each original task.
controlInspection.usageScope: Stored usage for profiles in the displayed task sample. No provider refresh is requested. Execution observations may be unavailable; configured profiles are not proof of the selected model.
controlInspection.noProfiles: No profile observation is available for the displayed tasks. This does not mean zero usage.
controlInspection.noUsage: No tracked execution observations. Usage is unknown, not zero.
controlInspection.usageUnknown: The execution usage source is unconfirmed. Unobserved values are not zero.
controlInspection.invalidTime: The execution observation time is missing or invalid; freshness cannot be confirmed.
controlInspection.usageDisabled: Stored execution usage is disabled. No usage was requested.
controlInspection.executionUnavailable: This execution observation could not be read.
controlInspection.usageUnsupported: Usage observation is not supported for this execution type.
controlInspection.accountUnknown: The account source for this execution could not be confirmed.
controlRestore.contractUnavailable: This build does not provide this overview. These values are unconfirmed.
controlRestore.historyScope: Events from the existing last 24 hours list, within your accessible workspaces. Counts and filters apply to the returned events.
controlRestore.providerScope: Provider quota usage, recorded model activity and workspace routing health have different sources and scopes.
controlRestore.windowsUnknown: Usage windows and their periods are unconfirmed because the saved observation contains none.
controlRestore.modelActivityScope: Last 7 days, up to 5 model names per workspace, as recorded in session profile snapshots: sessions, turns and recorded duration. This does not prove the model actually selected for an AI call. Ephemeral and automation tasks are excluded. Provider/account attribution and quota usage are not supplied.
controlRestore.processScope: Process session states are separate from actual AI inference. The overview API must supply its measured counts and sampling time.
controlRestore.limit.not-limited: No limit in the saved observation
controlRestore.limit.expired: The saved reset time has passed. Current block state is unconfirmed.
controlRestore.nativeSampleScope: Counts below cover {{shown}} sampled tasks out of {{total}} unarchived tasks. A running process does not prove an AI call is active.
controlRestore.usageReadPaused: Account usage is unconfirmed. Automatic usage reads are paused because the available read may contact a provider. Recorded model statistics and workspace health remain available.
controlRestore.nativeHealthScope: Stored routing health for the accessible workspaces shown below. These records do not establish complete account inventory, quota usage or global model circuit state. An elapsed retry time does not confirm recovery.
controlRestore.noProviderHealth: No non-healthy provider routing records were returned for this workspace.
controlRestore.retryElapsed: The recorded retry time has passed. Recovery has not been confirmed.
controlRestore.noModelActivity: No model activity was returned within this recorded sample.
controlRestore.partialMeasurements: Some measurements are unavailable. Source reasons: {{reasons}}.
controlNative.historyCoverage: Each workspace has its own trailing 24-hour read. Counts are returned/recorded totals per source; unavailable families are unknown. Finish records do not classify failures. Reads are not an atomic snapshot.
controlNative.metricScope: Recorded task, process and queue states. Completions and transitions cover 24 hours. Live inference, last output and age/dependency heuristics are unconfirmed.
controlNative.taskScope: Filters use recorded states. Problems mean a failed task or failed primary session. Row time is the last update; completion uses recorded transitions within 24 hours.
controlNative.ledgerScope: Last 24 hours from recorded usage events. Model/provider fields retain their recorded provenance; account attribution is unavailable. Unreported measurements remain unknown. Cost retains the source subcent unit.
controlNative.noSupportedEvents: No events were returned from the supported sources in these workspace samples.
controlRefresh.refreshing: Refreshing; showing the last confirmed sample
controlRefresh.retainedError: Refresh failed; showing the last confirmed sample
controlRefresh.unattributedScope: These cached reports do not identify a provider account. They do not confirm the current model selection or admission state.
controlRefresh.capacityClock: The response time is not the inference collection time. Source collection time is not provided.
